verdict.rationale: Paxos documents conversion as a first-class API capability — mint (USD→stablecoin) and redeem (stablecoin→USD) orchestrations execute conversion-and-transfer in one call, plus a generic 'execute conversions between supported assets' endpoint and held-rate quotes in crypto brokerage — supported by transfer status/list endpoints for settlement tracking. However documented fee schedules and explicit settlement-time SLAs per asset pair are not shown, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of rates or fees is present (OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s). missing for 10: documented fee schedules per conversion pair, explicit settlement-time guarantees/SLAs, independent verification of quote accuracy, accessible OpenAPI/schema confirming rate/fee fields.
